notes.title: College Kings 2 - Episode 1 Major Update OUT NOW
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=AAsp2ShwR5Y;full][/previewyoutube]

The community feedback driven Episode 1 Major Update is finally here, and it's free to all existing owners! We care deeply that you love the games you buy from us, which is why we spend the last two months improving Episode 1 based on your comments.

What you can expect:
✅ A more refined episode from start to finish
✅ More intimacy and romance, especially if you're in a relationship
✅ New scenes
✅ New choices
✅ New ending
✅ Improved save transfers

We're committed to focusing on the most important aspect of CK: your relationships. Not everything has to be all drama, gloom and doom at San Vallejo College; sometimes you just want to hang out in the park or cuddle up for a movie date with the babes. We’re also introducing growing problems for the frats that will play out over the rest of the season and culminate in the Summer Showdown. You’re in for a wild ride with the gang with lots more episodes to come in the future!

These improvements are inspired by your feedback, so please continue to share your thoughts with us as we continue to develop College Kings 2 (with Episode 2 planned for release later in 2022). 

We are really excited about the major release and recommend you replay CK2 Episode 1 from the beginning for the full experience (and transfer your saves from CK1 if you haven't yet).

Lastly, for a limited time only, College Kings 2 is [b]10% OFF[/b] on Steam as part of the Steam Summer Sale.

[b]Get the CK2 Episode 1 Major Update: [/b] [url=steam://openurl/https://store.steampowered.com/app/1924480/College_Kings_2__Act_I ]steam://openurl/https://store.steampowered.com/app/1924480/College_Kings_2__Act_I [/url]

- Undergrad Steve

notes.title: College Kings 2 Episode 1 Major Update Coming on June 23rd
notes.content:
[h1][b]College Kings 2 Episode 1 Major Update Coming on June 23rd [/b][/h1]

[previewyoutube=c4r_q66XDnc;full][/previewyoutube]

It’s been 2 months since the initial release of College Kings 2 Episode 1. After listening to all your feedback and putting in a lot of work, we are proud to announce the upcoming launch of our major update to Episode 1 on June 23rd!

We have refined the game from start to finish, added new scenes, new choices, and even a brand-new ending. All of this content will be free to existing owners of College Kings 2 Episode 1.

We’ve packaged a ton of goodies into the new build, including more opportunities to spend one-on-one time with your favorite characters and improved save transfers from CK1! We highly recommend you replay the episode once the update is out.

The vast majority of these improvements are inspired by your feedback and discussions in the community, so please continue to share your thoughts with us. We are excited about the major upcoming update coming next week and hope you enjoy it!

The major update will come to Steam on Thursday, June 23rd!

notes.title: Announcing College Kings 2!
notes.content:
When College Kings started as a bedroom project just 18 months ago, we never imagined the huge amount of popularity it would gain. We didn’t intend to do more than 3 acts, but with such an incredible community, there is simply no way we’re stopping now.

Since our humble beginnings, we have grown to become a studio of award-winning writers, accomplished artists and brilliant coders. With our team constantly raising the bar for what it means to be an Adult Visual Novel, [b]we believe it’s time for a new beginning.[/b]

College Kings has never been more exciting. Welcome to the new era of stunning visuals, immersive sex scenes and a vast branching narrative where every choice matters.

[b]College Kings 2 Act I will replace what used to be Act IV[/b], with the story continuing right where Act III left off. But don’t worry, your decisions and relationships from the first game carry over.

[b]What you can expect from College Kings 2:[/b]
[list]
[*] Get excited for more content in every release
[*] Experience gorgeous graphics and cinematic artwork
[*] Shape the story, with more player impact than ever before
[*] Be fully immersed in beautiful high-definition animations
[*] Feel as if you’re there through all new sex scene voice acting
[*] Live out your fantasies with interactive foreplay
[*] Combine strategy and satisfying knockouts in the overhauled turn-based fight system
[*] Say goodbye to bugs with our reformed code structure
[*] Enjoy fast, stable downloads with small file sizes
[*] And for the first time ever, collect College Kings Steam Trading Cards
[/list]
College Kings 2 Act I is coming to Steam on April 14th.

[b]Wishlist College Kings 2 Act I now:[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1924480/College_Kings_2__Act_I

To celebrate this new era of College Kings, we are making the first game, including all DLC, completely free with the launch of College Kings 2 Act I.
Additionally, we are adding more content to Act III which includes the conclusion of the Europe trip and multiple brand new, voice acted sex scenes!

Obviously a lot of you have already purchased Act II & III and we don't want you to feel as though you’re missing out. That’s why we’re giving anyone that bought Act II or III on Steam before the launch of College Kings 2 a free copy of the official CK walkthrough, filled with 220 pages of guidance on how to get every scene, achievement and relationship in the game.

Unfortunately Steam does not allow us to automatically carry your Act IV wishlist over to College Kings 2, so make sure you re-wishlist the game now!

[url=https://giv.gg/ck2]We’re still giving away 100 free copies on release.[/url]

If you’ve already entered the giveaway, make sure to also wishlist College Kings 2 Act I for the best chance of winning!

notes.title: College Kings Act 2 Amendments & Act 3 Announcement
notes.content:
[b]Act 2 Amendments[/b]
It's been over 2 months now since we released Act 2 on Steam and we have been overwhelmed by the support you have shown us! We are also very aware of your feedback regarding the Act however, and have been working on fixing bugs, story inconsistencies and the overall finish of the Act to create a more enjoyable experience for you. These updates should be coming out over the next few weeks but I will make another announcement when we have finished them all :)

[b]Act 3 Announcement[/b]
We will be releasing the steam page for the Act 3 DLC later this week along with our biggest steam key giveaway so far. The announcement will come with a provisional release date and although we will try our best to meet it, we won't sacrifice the quality of the game in order to reach it should it not be ready. The early access feedback we have had so far on Act 3 has been great and it's shaping up to be by far the best act yet!

- Undergrad Steve

notes.title: College Kings v0.6 Release & Steam Achievements
notes.content:
The 0.6 update is here! This update adds almost an hour of new story, developing character paths and giving you more pathing than ever before. 

[b]Due to significant changes in code, saves from previous versions will not work. This is a one time occurrence and your saves will be compatible with future updates. We apologize for the inconvenience.[/b]

CHANGELOG V0.6

New content:
* 1200+ New Renders
* 20+ New Animations
* 3 Dates
* 2 Sex Scenes
* Wolves Rush Party
* Lots of main & side story progression

Gameplay:
* Even more pathing, making your choices matter more than ever before
* Added new achievements
* Added new scenes to scene selector
* New phone messages now rise to the top of contacts
* Steam Achievements support now added!

General Improvements:
* Changed a lot of the code, including revamping the entire phone code to enable a better foundation for the future

Bug Fixes:
* Fixed spelling & grammar errors from previous versions
* Fixed a lot of bugs
